CREATOR SPOTLIGHT // @SLEEPYBADWAYZ

From Brooklyn Streets to Colorado Springs Stages

Born in Brooklyn, New York and operating Badwayz Society in Colorado Springs, Colorado, Sleepybadwayz (Christopher Brown) blends independent hip-hop, live local showcases, and underground streetwear into a single movement. Every piece in the Badwayz Society catalog is built around the same ethos:

"BADWAYZ SOCIETY - WHERE HUSTLE MEETS STYLE. Join the Culture. Wear the Legacy. Grind hard. Look good doing it. Badwayz Society represents the streets the struggle, and success that comes from never giving up."
